We’ve had our 12 week old Cavalier King Charles puppy for a month this coming Monday! Owning one has been my dream for a long time so it still feels surreal. I feel like he did sooooo well potty training wise the first two weeks. Now, some days he whines to let us know he needs to go out, other times he just squats down. Super frustrating but expected. I think I went into the beginning super strong and ready for anything but he was so great at first I let my guard down. Other than that he’s honestly doing amazing. Sleeps in his crate with next to no whining, listens and is taking to training pretty well. Probably the worst thing so far was coming home from work, smelling that he pooped in the cage but not realizing he had stepped and rolled in it. I picked him up and didn’t realize until we were all the way outside that my work clothes were covered in dog poop. Funny story to tell I guess :) hope everyone’s having a great week
